subject: Sponsor on-call rota + final-push timeline for close
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@synthix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor on-call rota + final-push timeline for close

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the call yesterday. As discussed, we want to lock the executive-sponsor on-call rota and the EB (executive briefing) schedule so your committee has the right stakeholders during the final evaluation window. I've attached an updated mutual action plan (MAP) with the last two sprint checkpoints and a proposed EB calendar.

High-level ask: can you confirm the sponsor availability below and whether Procurement will accept a 7-business-day turnaround on the SOW and PO once final pricing is signed?

Proposed sponsor rota (2-week final push):
- Week 1 (Nov 8–12): Liam O'Connor (Exec sponsor, product) — availability: Tue/Thu mornings
- Week 2 (Nov 15–19): Anjali Mehta (CIO) — availability: Wed/Fri afternoons

Proposed EB windows (30–45m):
- Nov 10, 09:00–09:45 PT — internal demo + Q&A (stakeholder working session)
- Nov 17, 13:00–13:45 PT — Exec briefing with sponsor + procurement presence

I've cc'd Marissa and Karthik to propose alignment steps from our side (rollout plan and risk mitigations). If those EB windows don't work, send two alternative 30m slots and we'll adapt.

Attachments: SYNIX-MAP-v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones & gate criteria), EB-invite-draft.ics

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

---
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@synthix.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anjali Mehta <anjali@synthix.com>, Procurement <procurement@synthix.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor on-call rota + final-push timeline for close

Maya —

Appreciate the summary and the MAP. Quick answers:
- Sponsor availability: confirm Nov 10 morning is OK for me (I can do 09:00 PT). Anjali is OOO on Nov 10 but Nov 17 afternoon works for her.
- Procurement: we run approvals quickly but need the final SOW and a short checklist for our legal team. 7 business days is tight but feasible if we get the final docs (SOW + pricing appendices) by Nov 9 COB.

Couple of asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a short technical readout (1 pager) showing data residency and KV-cache behavior under our expected request profile? Our compliance lead asked for that before the EB.
2) We'll need an escalation contact for run-of-show in case the EB needs deeper infra presence.

I can ping Procurement to prioritize the PO review once we see the SOW.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Product, Synthix Inc
liam.oconnor@synthix.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@synthix.com>, Anjali Mehta <anjali@synthix.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor on-call rota + final-push timeline for close

Maya / Karthik —

Notes from our internal pre-brief:
- Action: I'll prepare the 1-pager for data residency + KV-cache implications (target: Nov 8 EOD). Karthik will add the perf SLOs and a short runbook for EB escalation.
- Run-of-show contact: Ben Carter (cc'd below) will be the infra escalation lead during the EB windows. Ben, please keep Nov 10 08:30–10:00 PT and Nov 17 12:30–14:00 PT blocked for quick availability.

On the MAP: we reduced the acceptance criteria to three gated items to avoid analysis paralysis: integration smoke tests, SLA regression <5% vs baseline, and production-ready infra checklist. If Procurement needs the SOW by Nov 9 COB, we need a locked pricing appendix by Nov 5 COB so legal can fold it into the SOW.

I'll attach a short canary roll plan and a trimmed MAP export in the next email. Proposed final timeline:
- Nov 5: pricing appendix locked
- Nov 8: technical 1-pager + runbook delivered
- Nov 9: final SOW sent to Synthix
- Nov 10: EB (Liam) — decision checkpoint
- Nov 16: procurement signoff window opens
- Nov 19: target PO signed

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & Strategic Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@synthix.com>, Anjali Mehta <anjali@synthix.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@synthix.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor on-call rota + final-push timeline for close

Liam / Anjali —

Follow-ups:
- Attached: SYNIX-MAP-v2.xlsx (exported gating matrix) and EB-invite-draft.ics — please accept the Nov 10 09:00 PT slot (Liam) and Nov 17 13:00 PT slot (Anjali) if those still work.
- Technical 1-pager: delivered inline below (short):
    * Data residency: customer tenant in us-west-2, data at rest encrypted via KMS, logs forwarded to your SIEM via authenticated stream; no model weights leave customer VPC during private deployment.
    * KV-cache behavior: prefix caching enabled for conversational paths; warm-up latency controlled via pre-warm policy in the MAP (expected cold-start tokens < 30ms).
    * SLOs: p99 latency target 220ms for 4k context with our optimized kernels.

Ben will be the EB escalation contact: ben_carter@redwood.ai, +1 (650) 555-0133. For procurement questions, please loop in Procurement alias above.

If Synthix confirms acceptance by Nov 9 COB, we'll prepare an initial invoice and send a DocuSign-ready SOW immediately after signoff.

Thanks — looking forward to the EB.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: SYNIX-MAP-v2.xlsx, EB-invite-draft.ics
